title: Recollements of Cohen-Macaulay Auslander algebras for gentle algebras
summary: We construct two recollements of module categories for the Cohen--Macaulay Auslander algebra $A^{\mathrm{CMA}}$ of a gentle algebra $A$. In this paper, we establish three equivalent characterizations for the quotient algebra $A^{\mathrm{CMA}}/A^{\mathrm{CMA}}(1-ε_{\star}) A^{\mathrm{CMA}}$ of the CM--Auslander algebra of $A$ to be quasi-tilted, precisely, the following statements are equivalent: (1) $A^{\mathrm{CMA}}/A^{\mathrm{CMA}}(1-ε_{\star}) A^{\mathrm{CMA}}$ is quasi-tilted; (2) $\mathrm{findim} A\leqslant 2$, and for each forbidden $A$-module $M$,…
